summary: Validated new features: Reports date filtering, CSV export, PDF export, Leaflet map on Rotas, and OSRM/Nominatim route planning. All 10 pytest backend tests passed, and the frontend flows (admin + driver) worked end-to-end. Reports 403 for driver is now handled gracefully via <Navigate to='/' replace/>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single-file 199-line module with all routes packed on single lines; for future scale, split into routers/auth/models (but acceptable for current MVP size).

/api/routes/plan performs blocking `requests.get` calls in an async endpoint with `time.sleep(1.05)` - this blocks the event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient + asyncio.sleep for concurrency under load.

Reports date filter compares `created_at` (ISO string) with $gte/$lte string range - works only because ISO 8601 lexicographic order matches chronological order; safe but fragile if any doc uses non-ISO format.

Frontend exportCSV uses fetch with auth headers via cookie fallback; note that `auth()` returns object with `headers` but is passed as second fetch arg (which expects the init object). Works because init={headers:{Authorization:...}} matches. Verified downloads OK.
App.js is ~225 lines with many components on single lines - readable but hard to review; recommend splitting components into files.
